VCST-5433-catalog-red-dark.png (Show in stock chip, red checkbox, green stock badges, red discount badge)

signin-alert (danger), cart (warning 'Complete all required information'), signup (info password tips)
dashboard (New=green, Processing=blue), lists (count badge), catalog (filter chip), cart (6 VARIATIONS chip)

checks.desc: Account dashboard (orders table, status, spend donut)

PR #2407 still OPEN/unmerged though its build is live on vcst-qa (normal pre-merge QA)
B2B org-specific pages (company members/org management) not swept — logged-in fixture is a personal B2C user; identical component set, low risk
